name: led-xinglight-2835-yellowwhite
description: XINGLIGHT XL-2835YWC-02 2835 phosphor-converted 'yellow white' LED, 1800-1900 K, 60 mA, 200 mW, Vf 3.0-3.4 V, 120 deg, 5.5-6.2 cd (~18 lm). Almost all of its blue pump is converted by a broad yellow phosphor, so it plays the 'lime' role in a colour mix: one wide band filling 520-650 nm (LCSC C7371920). Same footprint as the XL-2835 blue/green

vf_trim.description: forward-voltage offset in volts for this LED (bin/part spread); the series source V<ref>_trim also measures the LED current: probe i(V<ref>_trim)

spice.model:
* XINGLIGHT XL-2835YWC-02 (InGaN pump + phosphor), fitted for 3.20 V at 60 mA (catalogue 3.0-3.4 V), tempco -2.5 mV/K; vf_trim=+0.20 is the maximum.
